title: An Act to Support the Maine Service Fellows Program (TITLE CHANGE)

summary.text: 3206 This bill provides ongoing funds for 20 program fellows to participate in the Maine 3217 Service Fellows Program. The bill also directs the Maine Commission for Community 3228 Service, in conjunction with the Department of Defense, Veterans and Emergency 3239 Management, to compile a list of volunteers who are available at the request of the Governor during states of emergency to provide emergency response and support services in coordination with the Maine Emergency Management Agency.
